title: On Robustness of Prompt-based Semantic Parsing with Large Pre-trained Language Model: An Empirical Study on Codex
abstract: arXiv:2301.12868v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Semantic parsing is a technique aimed at constructing a structured representation of the meaning of a natural-language question. Recent advancements in few-shot language models trained on code have demonstrated superior performance in generating these representations compared to traditional unimodal language models, which are trained on downstream tasks. Despite these advancements, existing fine-tuned neural semantic parsers are susceptible to adversarial attacks on natural-language inputs. While it has been established that the robustness of smaller semantic parsers can be enhanced through adversarial training, this approach is not feasible for large language models in real-world scenarios, as it requires both substantial computational resources and expensive human annotation on in-domain semantic parsing data. This paper presents the first empirical study on the adversarial robustness of a large prompt-based language model of code,

translated_title: 基于大型预训练语言模型的提示式语义解析的鲁棒性研究：Codex实证分析
translated_abstract: 语义解析是一种旨在构建自然语言问题含义的结构化表示的技术。近年来，在代码上训练的少样本语言模型在生成这些结构化表示方面展现出优于传统单模态语言模型（即在下游任务上训练的模型）的性能。尽管取得了这些进展，现有的微调神经语义解析器仍然容易受到针对自然语言输入的对抗性攻击。虽然已有研究表明，较小的语义解析器的鲁棒性可以通过对抗训练来增强，但这种方法对于现实场景中的大语言模型而言并不可行，因为它既需要大量的计算资源，又需要对域内语义解析数据进行昂贵的人工标注。本文首次对基于提示的大型代码语言模型的对抗鲁棒性进行了实证研究。
tldr: 本文首次对基于提示的大型代码语言模型（Codex）在语义解析任务中的对抗鲁棒性进行了实证研究。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first empirical study on the adversarial robustness of a large prompt-based code language model (Codex) for semantic parsing.
